abstract: The concentrations of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) and its free immunoreactive alpha-subunit (hCG-alpha) in the sera of patients with trophoblastic diseases were measured by hCG and hCG-alpha radioimmunoassay (RIA), respectively. In the sera of 12 women with hydatidiform mole large amounts of hCG and considerably high level of hCG-alpha were detected in all cases. After the evacuation of mole the serum level of these glycoproteins decreased, the leve of hCG-alpha declined more rapidly than hcg. in the sera of patients with destructive mole the concentration of hCG-alpha was usually lower than that of hCG. After hysterectomy and chemotherapy the levels of hCG-alpha declined practically paralleling that of hCG. However, when hCG had decreased to undetectable level, hCG-alpha could no longer be detected in all cases. Although in the serum of patient with choriocarcinoma involving the uterus and lungs the concentration of hCG-alpha was almost as high as that of hCG, the secretory pattern of hCG and hCG-alpha might not be closely related. The changes in the serum level of free hCG-alpha as well as that of hCG parelled the clinical course of the patients examined in this study. The present results suggest that measurements of the serum free hCG-alpha may be a useful parameter to follow the clinical course and to evaluate the efficacy of treatments of trophoblastic diseases.
abstract_ja: 絨毛性疾患患者の血清中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)および遊離免疫反応性αサブユニット(hCG-α)濃度を、それぞれhCGおよびhCG-α放射免疫測定法(RIA)により測定した。胞状奇胎の女性12例の血清では、全例で多量のhCGと相当高値のhCG-αが検出された。奇胎除去後、これらの糖タンパク質の血清中濃度は低下し、hCG-αはhCGよりも速く低下した。破壊性奇胎の患者の血清では、hCG-α濃度は通常hCG濃度より低かった。子宮摘出術と化学療法の後、hCG-αの濃度はhCGの濃度とほぼ並行して低下した。しかし、hCGが検出不能レベルまで低下すると、全例でhCG-αも検出されなくなった。子宮と肺に浸潤した絨毛癌の患者の血清では、hCG-α濃度はhCGとほぼ同等に高値であったが、hCGとhCG-αの分泌パターンは密接に関連しない可能性がある。遊離hCG-αおよびhCGの血清中濃度の変化は、本研究で検討した患者の臨床経過と並行していた。本結果は、血清中の遊離hCG-α測定が絨毛性疾患の臨床経過の追跡および治療効果の評価に有用なパラメータとなりうることを示唆している。
